messages:
alex: quick q — thinking about adding a rehearsal flow in the console: one-click simulate that runs a staged config through shadow routing + quota checks so owners can preview cost/latency/regression signals before flipping a flag. thoughts?
priya: love it. need clear UX: show expected token burn delta, P95 latency delta, and a confidence band. CTA to pin safety thresholds. :thumbsup:
marco: traffic source? synthetic generators or sampled live requests? sampling cheaper but can miss edge spikes.
nina: reuse shadow-routing infra but mark traces as rehearsal with a label so they don't mix into prod analytics.
andrew: ops concern: rehearsals must never bill customers or consume their quotas. we should compute cost estimates offline instead of charging.
jin: propose API + console action: POST /v1/configs/rehearsals {config_id, scope, sample_rate, dry_run:true} -> rehearsal_id + quick report. e.g. POST /v1/configs/rehearsals {"config_id":"cfg-2026-abc","scope":"route:chat-prod","sample_rate":0.05}
sam: safety gates: auto-pause if error-rate delta > X or token delta > Y. thresholds per-org.
devops-bot: rehearsal-created config_rehearsal=cfg-2026-abc preview=1750202023
emma: UI: diff view + timeline with expected resource curve. link affected quotas and dedicated pools.
priya: telemetry must include quality signals (eval set scoring) so we catch model-regression, not just perf.
marco: compatibility: older runtime clients won't send new rehearsal header; run server-side shadowing to avoid client changes.
jin: also offer SDK helper for sandbox rehearsals, but default is server-side.
andrew: we need an abort API + webhook on gate breach so automation can stop promos.
alex: add admin audit entry for every rehearsal with commit/PR link and rehearsal_id; searchable in console.
sam: reserve small rehearsal budget per-org to avoid rehearsal storms skewing global telemetry; show budget usage in console.
ops-bot: coord with quota team for reservation changes — ticket ENG-REH-57 created.
priya: UI: include a Promote button that does a final fast-check (0.5% live sample) giving estimated rollout time and rollback preview; grey out promote unless checklist complete.
emma: checklist: audit log present, safety gates set, baseline telemetry captured.
marco: infra plan: reuse sampling + shadow routing, add rehearsal-aggregation pipeline computing P50/95 token delta, error delta, eval-score delta. store rehearsal reports for 30d.
jin: downsample signals to keep storage cost low; store full traces only on flagged regressions.
devops-bot: rehearsal-1750202022 completed -> report at /console/configs/cfg-2026-abc/rehearsals/1750202023 (stub).
sam: auto-canary concept: increase sample_rate if gates pass (0.05 -> 0.25 -> 1.0) with quiescent windows. require explicit opt-in on promote.
andrew: agree but default is manual step-up.
alex: I'll draft short RFC with endpoints, console mocks, telemetry schema, gate defs. ping @priya @marco @nina to review.
priya: add me, will help UX & gate wording.
marco: taking infra; will prototype perf-budget calc.
nina: mapping telemetry labels & eval hooks.
alex: filing RFC now, thanks all.
ops-bot: FYI — DM ops for sandbox token if you want an immediate rehearsal.
